# A text area's value is written back on every keystroke

## Context

Flagged as unverified in #18910's out-of-scope. Measured now, browser first (@tobiu's bar for this class: a component or e2e proof, not a unit-runtime story).

## The Problem

**Measured, component tier — real Chromium, real keys, `apps/empty-viewport`, `dev@576da9b731`.** Instrument: the `value` setter of `HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype` / `HTMLInputElement.prototype` wrapped on the main thread; every programmatic write passes it, typing does not. Typed: `the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog`.

| Field | App Worker | programmatic `value` writes | typed text |
|---|---|---|---|
| `form.field.Text` (control) | idle | 0 | intact 3 of 3 |
| `form.field.TextArea` | idle, 12 chars/s | 35 — about one per keystroke, each equal to what the DOM holds | intact 3 of 3 |
| `form.field.TextArea` | blocked 30 of every 40 ms, 12 chars/s | 35, none lossy | intact 3 of 3 |
| `form.field.TextArea` | blocked 120 of every 140 ms, 20 chars/s | 21–23, **4–6 of them an OLDER value over newer typing** | **corrupted 3 of 3**: `the quick brownfox jumps over thelazy dog` |
| `form.field.Text` (control) | blocked 120 of every 140 ms, 20 chars/s | 0 | intact 3 of 3 |

So a text area has none of the input sync a text field has. With an idle worker that is waste — a delta and a DOM write per keystroke. With a busy one — the App Worker is where a Neo app does its heavy lifting — it is the data loss #18792, #18910 and #18914 closed for text fields, still open for every text area.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/form/field/Text.mjs` finds the real input's vnode by tag, in both places that keep it honest:
- `onInputValueChange()`: `VNodeUtil.find(me.vnode, {nodeName: 'input'})` — the sync of what the DOM reported into the vnode (+ `reportedInputValue`).
- `afterVnodeSync(deltas)` (#18926): the same lookup, restoring the report into a landed vnode.

`form.field.TextArea` extends `Text` and changes the real input's tag to `textarea` (`changeInputElKey('tag', …)`). Neither lookup finds it, so neither the sync nor the restore ever runs, and every `afterSetValue() → update()` diffs the new value against a vnode that still holds the old one.

The node has a stable id, `getInputElId()` — `afterVnodeSync()` already matches deltas by it — and `VNodeUtil.find()` takes an id.

## The Fix

Both lookups find the real input by `getInputElId()` instead of by tag name. No TextArea override, no new API.

## Decision Record impact

none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: component tier — typing into a `TextArea` causes no programmatic write of its value; red on `dev` (one per keystroke).
- [ ] AC-2: the same arm shape stays green for `Text` (#18923's witness), and #18792 / #18910 / #18914's unit and e2e arms stay green.
- [ ] AC-3: a value set in code still reaches a text area's DOM (CONTROL).

## Out of Scope

- An arm that reproduces the corruption itself: it needs a deliberately blocked App Worker and timing, and "no programmatic write while typing" is the deterministic form of the same claim.

## Avoided Traps

- **A `TextArea` override of the two methods.** The lookup by tag is the defect; a second copy of it with another tag keeps the defect's shape for the next subclass that changes the tag.
